configs.description: C1300-24P-4G - 24 10/100/1000 PoE+ ports with a 195 W budget and four 1 Gigabit SFP uplink cages, a built-in AC supply and no fan. The box holds the 19-inch brackets, the power cord (unless the NO-POWER-CORD option is ordered) and a pointer card.
configs.name: base

gaps.note: No held document shows the C1300-24P-4G's rear. The data sheet (p33) lists the model under "100-240V 50-60 Hz, internal, universal" and gives no inlet type or position, so the rear is left empty and no AC inlet is placed; the DCIM export carries no power port. The 24T's rear is a reading of the 24T and is not used.
gaps.wanted: A rear elevation or photograph of the C1300-24P-4G showing its AC inlet.

gaps.note: The data sheet says the 19-inch brackets ship with the switch and holds no figure of them, no position and no part number. No Catalyst 1300 installation guide is held. The ears are declared with the default position and no `at`, and no kit is listed.
gaps.wanted: The Catalyst 1300 hardware installation guide's rack-mounting section.

gaps.note: The data sheet lists the LEDs "System, Link/Act, PoE, Speed" and nothing more; no document held says which lamp shows what, where the PoE and Speed lamps are, or whether the arrows by the ports are the Link/Act lamps. The arrows and the System lamp carry the component's own vocabulary and no meaning is stated.

The data sheet names a USB Type-C port and no Type-A; the NetBox elevation shows a Type-A port above the RJ-45 jack and NetBox lists a USB-A console. The Type-A port is drawn from the elevation as a USB port, not a console. Its generation is not stated.

The antenna pictogram on the bracket over the cages is drawn as an outline from the elevation (estimated: the symbol is about 3 mm across at 5.5 px per mm). The two pictograms on the PoE bracket line and the dots by the PoE legend are too small in the elevation to draw; what they mean is not stated in any held document.
gaps.wanted: A close-up of the front panel.

gaps.note: Cisco's series page lists the model with no end-of-sale notice when the sources were gathered; no end-of-life page was held, so none is quoted.

gaps.wanted: `attrs.platform.cpu` (profile `networking` - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml) - unlocks the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on port groups rj45, sfp - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

built-in-power-and-fans.note: "100-240V 50-60 Hz, internal, universal" (p33): the supply is built into the chassis, part of it and not a bay. The C1300-24P-4G is fanless (p34), so no fan is drawn and no fan bay is declared. The data sheet states no fan redundancy.

buttons.note: One recessed round button with a reset pictogram above it (data sheet: "Reset button"), drawn with the library's reset-button part.

chassis.note: 444.3 x 299 x 43.94 mm (17.49 x 11.77 x 1.73 in), data sheet p30, in its W x D x H order. 444.3 is the body: the elevation shows no ears and the jack pitch closes on the registry at that width. 1RU. Weight 3.53 kg (7.78 lb), p32.

console-and-usb.note: The data sheet (p25) lists "Cisco standard RJ-45 console port and USB Type C port", the USB port as the USB Type C port "on the front panel of the switch for easy file and image management as well as console port", and one reset button; its text on the Bluetooth dongle (p4) says the dongle "plugs into the USB port on the switch". THE ELEVATION SHOWS A USB TYPE-A PORT as well: the upper half of the stacked housing is a Type-A opening under a USB symbol, the lower half the RJ-45, and the USB Type-C port stands to their left. NetBox lists three console ports for the model: RJ-45, USB-C and USB-A. The data sheet names no Type-A port, so it is drawn from the elevation only, as a USB port and not as a console, and the data sheet's USB Type-C port is the console. The blue strip under the three ports carries a console pictogram, and is drawn as that strip. The Type-A port's generation is not stated, so the white (USB 2.0) skin is used, which claims less than the blue one; the elevation shows a dark tongue.

ears.note: "Only 24-and 48-port models include the 19-in mounting brackets with the switch" (p35, again p40) and the ordering table reads "Rack-mountable" (p36). No held document draws the brackets, gives their positions or a part number, so the shipped position is declared as the default with no `at`, no kit is listed and the ears are not drawn. The accessory table's RCKMNT-CMPCT-1K= is for the 8, 12 and 16 port models and is not this device's.

front-layout.note: From the NetBox front elevation at 5.58 px per mm across and 5.48 down. Two beige jack plates 87.6 and 87.3 mm wide at 168.2 and 272.2 mm, top 8.7 mm, 26.5 mm tall. Six columns of two jacks in each on the registry's 13.97 mm pitch, the first jack at 170.3 mm and the seventh at 274.5 mm, a 20.28 mm gutter beyond the pitch. The upper row's jack openings read 61 to 117 px and the lower row's 142.7 to 199.3 px, which puts the cell tops at 9.5 and 23.9 mm, a 14.4 mm row step. The upper jacks show their keyway up and the lower their keyway down. The four SFP cages are 14.0 mm wide at a 19.0 mm step, centres 372.3, 391.3, 410.3 and 429.3 mm, and read 142 to 200 px down, centred 29.6 mm, so the 14.5 x 10.0 registry cage is placed on those centres. The stacked housing at the left is 16.8 x 21.7 mm at 30.8, 13.0 mm. Its USB Type-A opening is 13.7 x 6.1 mm centred 39.2, 17.2 mm and its RJ-45 opening 13.2 x 10.6 mm centred 39.2, 29.3 mm; the registry parts are centred on those. The USB Type-C port reads 9.6 x 3.3 mm centred 23.1, 33.2 mm. The reset button is 4.1 mm across, centred 12.0, 31.0 mm. The colours are medians of the elevation: face #e5e5e4, plates #c8bfb5, console strip #b2d3e1, PoE strip #ead55f.

gate-1.note: The elevation is 2499 x 255 px, aspect 9.80, against 444.3 / 43.94 = 10.11 for the body. The picture is not the body alone: it carries a margin of about 6 px at the left and 10 px at the right, and a 9 px band of shadow and lip at the top and 5 px at the bottom, so the metal runs from x 5.5 to 2483 (2477 px) and from y 9 to 250 (241 px) and the body alone reads 10.28, 1.7% out the other way. Across, the 2477 px are the printed 444.3 mm: 5.58 px per mm. That is checked on a quantity the scale never saw: the RJ-45 jacks step 78.0 px over five steps, 13.98 mm against the registry's 13.97. Down, 241 px for the printed 43.94 mm is 5.48 px per mm, 1.8% under the horizontal, and the two jack rows centre 22.2 mm down against the face's 22.0. Every x below is (px - 5.5) / 5.58 and every y is (px - 9) / 5.48. Across the figures are good to about 0.2 mm; down to about 0.5 mm, because the vertical scale is taken from the lip lines and not from a feature of known size.

lamps.note: estimated - the elevation shows no lamp except the arrows. The data sheet's LED row (p25) lists "System, Link/Act, PoE, Speed" and no held document says where they are or what they show. The 28 grey arrows by the ports are drawn as the library's arrow lamps, the one thing on the face that sits by each port as a lamp does, and the faint two-gear pictogram under the reset button as the System lamp. Where the PoE and Speed lamps are is not shown. The arrows are at 3.4 mm and 10.4 mm from the left of each column and 39.2 mm down, read off the elevation; the cage arrows are centred under their cages.

logo.note: The Cisco logo and wordmark at 9.4 to 22.5 mm and 4.7 to 11.5 mm are not drawn; a logo-zone reserves the place. The printed "Catalyst 1300 Series" is drawn as plain text.

poe.note: PoE table (p20): "C1300-24P-4G, 195W, 24 ports"; ordering table (p36): "24x 10/100/1000 30W PoE+ ports with 195W power budget". The two agree. The PoE standards are "802.3at PoE+, 802.3af, and Cisco pre-standard (legacy) PoE" (p20).

poe-strip.note: A yellow strip under each jack block, 87.8 and 87.5 mm wide at 168.3 and 272.3 mm, 2.9 mm tall at 38.0 mm, with the arrows and the end numerals on it. Over the blocks a bracket line runs from 168.1 to 359.6 mm at 4.65 mm down, with rounded ends, broken in the middle for two small pictograms and the legend "-54VDC,0.55A FOR EACH PORT" starting at 246.0 mm. The pictograms (a PoE symbol and a second symbol beyond the legend) and the dots beside the legend are not drawn. A second bracket over the four cages, 364.6 to 436.8 mm at 20.25 mm, is broken in the middle for one pictogram that is not drawn either.

port-numbering.note: The elevation prints 1 and 12 at the ends of the first strip and 13 and 24 at the ends of the second, and 25 and 28 at the ends of the uplinks, with an arrow for each port: an up arrow under its column for the upper jack and a down arrow for the lower. So the upper jack of a column takes the odd number and the lower the even, as on cisco/ws-c4948e, and the numbers run along the columns from the left, 1 to 24, then the four cages 25 to 28. Only those six numerals are printed, and only those six are drawn. NetBox names the interfaces GigabitEthernet1 to 28 and types the four cages 1000base-x-sfp and the 24 jacks 1000base-t with PoE type 2 (802.3at); no Cisco document held gives interface names, so none is written as an `interfaces:` block.

power-use.note: Power consumption (worst case), p21: system 27.1 W at 110 V and 27.5 W at 220 V; with PoE 233.2 W at 110 V and 230.5 W at 220 V; 795.2 BTU/hr; idle 13.9 W at 110 V and 12.9 W at 220 V. The with-PoE figure is carried as the maximum.

rear-layout.note: No held document shows this model's rear: NetBox holds a rear elevation for the C1300-24T-4G only, and a relative is not evidence. The rear is left empty and no AC inlet is placed, so the DCIM export carries no power port. The 24T's rear is not used.

sources.note: "Cisco Catalyst 1300 and 1300X Series Switches" data sheet, Cisco public, (c) 2026, document 3659554-09, 41 pages (https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/products/collateral/switches/catalyst-1300-series-switches/nb-06-cat1300-ser-data-sheet-cte-en.pdf): the physical table (p25), the PoE table (p20), power use (p21), dimensions (p30-31), weights (p32), power, operating temperature and certifications (p33), fans and MTBF (p34), package contents (p35) and the ordering table (p36-37). The NetBox device type C1300-24P-4G and its front elevation cisco-c1300-24p-4g.front.png, community files and not Cisco's, for the front. No Catalyst 1300 installation guide, no photograph of a single SKU and no 3D model is held, and no NetBox rear elevation exists for this model. The data sheet's family photograph is unlabelled and is not used.
